verdict.rationale: Quo documents a public REST API at api.quo.com. The docs cover API-key authentication, JSON responses, and per-key rate limits. A downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec, a per-endpoint "Try it" playground with .md and llms.txt mirrors, and an explicit date-based versioning policy round out the reference. The 404s at the guessed openapi.json paths don't contradict this, because the spec is published at a linked S3 URL. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end to end; the probes only confirmed llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Quo API enables developers to integrate powerful communication features directly into their applications and workflows.
Include your API key in the Authorization header of each request: `Authorization: YOUR_API_KEY`
Each API key may make up to 10 requests per second.
